title: Trust Evaluation Mechanism for User Recruitment in Mobile Crowd-Sensing in the Internet of Things
reasoning: The paper deals with trust evaluation in Mobile Crowd-Sensing systems, which inherently involves assessing the ethical behavior of users (e.g., distinguishing trustworthy from malicious users, preventing falsified data). The concept of 'trust' itself, as modeled and evaluated in the paper, is a fundamental moral and ethical construct in human interaction.
